title: Brand Posts – Lukas Ude
description: A calm editorial post series for the Lukas Ude brand, built from the CI's image language and typography.

thumbnail.alt: Brand post: 'From idea to system.' over a river at sunset

objective: Make the brand idea visible in the feed: nature, craft and systems – calm instead of loud.
insight: In a feed full of hype, restraint stands out. Few words, strong typography, real atmosphere.
approach: CI typography: Cormorant Garamond for statements, Manrope for details
Images from the CI image language: warm light, deep shadows, nature
One thought per post – short enough to read while scrolling
